# Marvel Legends Chronicle

The complete chronological archive of every Marvel Legends action figure, 2002–2026.
Fan-made. Not affiliated with Marvel, Hasbro, or Toy Biz.

## What this is

- Timeline of 1,939 figures across 167 waves, Toy Biz (2002–2006) through Hasbro (2007–2026)
- Wave archive: 167 generated wave pages (`waves/<wave-id>.html` + index; rebuild with `python3 scripts/build_waves.py`) — every figure with inline Owned/Wanted toggles, BAF breakdown, research links, prev/next navigation, print checklist
- New collector starter guide (`start.html`): first pickups, how to read a wave, spotting fakes, BAF math, tracking, learning real prices
- Stats dashboard: figures per year, BAF waves over time, top 25 characters, exclusives share, wave-size breakdowns — all computed live from the data
- Collector encyclopedia: line history, packaging evolution, variant/chase/exclusive taxonomy, 23-entry hall of fame (with reissue-radar flags), grading guide, transparent price methodology, bootleg-spotting guide, resources
- BAF planner: mark owned figures, see missing Build-A-Figure pieces + acquisition guidance (browser-local)
- 66 character pages (`characters/<slug>.html`): every release of the most-collected characters, chronological
- Price journal: log eBay sold listings yourself; your collection's tracked value computed from your entries only; per-figure price trends (3+ logged sales) with SVG sparklines on the figure dialog + a ranked trends section — all from your own data, never a market index (browser-local)
- BAF economics (`baf-economics.html`): cost-to-complete per Build-A-Figure from your own journal sold sightings — ranked cheapest-first, pieces with no data flagged, owned pieces excludable (browser-local)
- Hunt planner (`hunt.html`): toy-show trip planner — targets from watchlist hunts + wanted list, per-figure max prices (prefilled from watchlist targets), printable hunt sheet with deal math from your journal medians (browser-local)
- Collection ledger (`collection-value.html`): log what you paid per figure; cost basis vs tracked value = unrealized gain/loss per figure and total (browser-local, `mlc_buys_v1`; values from your own entries only)
- Grail watchlist: track the figures you hunt, set your own max price, log sightings — deal-or-no-deal judged against your target; Price Watch compares each target against the Chronicle's reported market signals (`data/price-signals.json` — sold bands, averages, listings, claimed prices from encyclopedia/market-briefing research, labeled "reported ranges, not live prices"), with "$X above your target" verdicts and plain-text share export (browser-local)
- Budget Tracker (`budget.html`): a spend mirror (not a planner — no advice) over the purchases you log on the Ledger page (`mlc_buys_v1`): your own monthly/annual budgets (`mlc_budget_v1`), this-month/this-year progress vs budget, all-time stats (purchase count, total, average per figure, most expensive), recent purchases; feeds the Grail Quest's Budget Keeper achievement (browser-local)
- Exclusives browser: all 587 exclusives by retailer (Target, Walmart, Walgreens, Amazon, Hasbro Pulse, SDCC, TRU, Fan Channel…), with inline Owned/Wanted toggles and research links; 20 non-retailer entries grouped as "retailer unconfirmed" rather than guessed
- Your Shelf v2 analytics: manufacturer split (owned + wanted), peak collecting years, collection growth trend (daily snapshots), journal value over time (from your own entries), shelf-vs-archive rarity per packaging era, one-click shareable text summary for forums/Discord (browser-local)
- Bootleg authentication wizard: step-by-step pass/fail flow with verdict
- Price guide page: the sold-listings method, aggregator limits, dated price history, reissue effect
- Fan community (client-side demo): profiles, feed, likes, comments, follows, figure-tagged posts
- Collection tracker: mark figures Owned / Wanted (browser-local)
- Gift finder 2.0 (`gift.html`): budget + character/team + recipient (kid / casual fan / collector) → ranked picks from real archive signals (character/team keyword match, recency, figure type, rarity signals, KO-risk penalties); price tiers are figure-type classes never prices — the only dollars are your journal's sold prices or announced pre-order MSRPs; KO-risk notes from the archive's authentication research (`assets/js/ko-targets.js`); "buy this, not that" same-character alternates; market-briefing reissueRadar notes; pre-orderable flags from `data/preorders.json`; prefillable via `?budget=&for=&character=`; every card links eBay solds for real price verification — no invented prices)
- 2026 Holiday Buying Guide (`holiday.html`): four recipient profiles (New Collector — five $27.99 entry points; The Kid; The Completionist — 2026 gap-fills with researched pre-order dates; The Bargain Hunter — reissue intel) rendered live from `data/preorders.json`; honest price bands (announced MSRP or "check eBay solds"), KO red flags (Maximum Spider-Man / X-Men '97 Cyclops), chase-market reality, reissue timing; don't-get-burned checklist from the auth wizard + market briefing; holiday-mode banner on `gift.html`; prefilled Gift Finder deep links (`?budget=&for=&character=`) per profile
- "Almost there" on your shelf: BAFs missing 1–2 pieces, waves past 50%, characters nearly complete — computed from your tracker
- Grail stories: 20 sourced narratives expanding the hall of fame (legend, hunt, reissue saga, honest prices)
- Variant & chase identifier: spotter's guide + wave-by-wave index of all 83 documented variants
- Variant spotlight (`variant-spotlight.html`): 15 of the most interesting documented variants — why each matters, how to spot it (15 of 83, coverage stated)
- Printable checklist: your tracker as a paper checklist grouped by wave, with print stylesheet (also applied to the timeline)
- Archive explorer (`explore.html`): "Surprise me" seeded random-figure engine (no repeats until the deck is exhausted) + curated rabbit holes — variant oddities, deepest Toy Biz cuts, one-figure characters, the ten oldest BAFs — every result links its figure dialog and wave page (browser-local)
- Retro line browser (`retro.html`): all retro-carded figures identified from the archive's own notes (Marvel Retro waves, Retro fan channel, retro singles), grouped by retro line with coverage stated — retro status never guessed (browser-local)
- Shelfie showcase (`showcase.html`): curate your top 10 from owned figures, reorder by drag-and-drop or keyboard, one "why it made the cut" line per slot, printable layout; "Copy my quest" export (quest-card text: progress, achievements, next-quest list) shared with Grail Quest via `assets/js/quest-share.js` (browser-local); Shelf Gallery 2.0 — per-shelf photo slots (own photos via file input, stored as dataURLs in localStorage, client-side only, EXIF stripped on import, quota handling with downscale option), captions + figure-tagging against real archive ids, layout templates (grid / character-run row / BAF centerpiece), arrow-key + button reorder, Grail Quest header strip (level, achievements, rarest owned), "Shelfie share card" text export reusing quest-share logic (top figures, completion %, latest grail) with copy-to-clipboard

## API (static JSON, versioned)

Base: `api/v1/` — no auth, no keys, no rate limits. Full agent guide: `AGENT.md`.

- `api/v1/index.json` — self-describing manifest: every endpoint with path, description, schema + itemSchema URLs, ISO-8601 UTC `updated` timestamp, record counts, deprecation notes. Start here.
- `api/v1/stats.json` — totals, per-year and per-manufacturer counts, BAF/exclusive/variant tallies
- `api/v1/waves.json` — 167 wave summaries (id, year, manufacturer, series, baf, source, figureCount)
- `api/v1/figures.json` — flat list of all 1,939 figures with wave context (incl. `source`)
- `api/v1/encyclopedia.json` — history timeline, packaging evolution, variant/chase/exclusive taxonomy, hall of fame (with reissue radar), grading guide, transparent price methodology, bootleg guide, resources directory
- `api/v1/preorders.json` — 23 researched upcoming releases (15 wave-12 + 5 NYCC 2026 additions + 1 wave-24 Maximum Symbiote reveal + 1 wave-28 Holiday Spidey + 1 wave-30 Super-Skrull reissue, statuses refreshed Oct 12, 2026): status, exact pre-order dates where reported (null when unreported — never invented), release windows, announced MSRP, retailer search patterns, hobby-press sources, `windowResult` honesty-check field; powers the pre-order tracker + release calendar
- `api/v1/characters.json` — 66 character guides: slug, name, release count, first/last year, page path
- `api/v1/timeline.json` — The Legends Timeline: 25 year records (2002–2026) — era, headline, summary, sourced milestones, packaging notes, per-year wave records (real archive ids), spotlight figure ids; envelope carries the 5 packaging eras
- `api/v1/radar-candidates.json`, `api/v1/radar-seen.json` — hand-maintained reissue-radar research feed + processed-URL dedupe list
- `api/v1/rarity.json` — The Rarity Guide: 9 tier records (chase, running-change, deco, unmasked, convention, retailer, Pulse/Fan Channel, HasLab, made-to-order) — body, how-to-spot, value notes (reported prices only), archive signal counts, quest-achievement mapping; content from `data/rarity-guide.json` via `scripts/build_rarity.py`
- `api/v1/price-signals.json` — reported market price signals for the Price Watch: 10 curated records keyed to real figure ids — kind (sold-band/sold-avg/listing/claimed), low/high USD, display, source + sourceUrl, note, singleSource flag, asOf; envelope carries the methodology ("reported ranges, not live prices — no Chronicle price index")
- `api/v1/launch-curves.json` — The Launch Curve (wave 30): real sold-price timelines for newly launched figures — every point a reported eBay sold/presale from a named hobby tracker, with sellout event markers and MSRP; documents the sellout → spike → cool → retail pattern; reported timelines, not predictions; content from `data/launch-curves.json` via `scripts/build_launch.py`
- `api/v1/drop-week.json` — Drop Week Command Center (wave 32): the Oct 14 → Nov 1 drop sequence + Nov 20 made-to-order deadline — confirmed windows, lineups with researched accessory notes, announced prices (msrp/unannounced — never invented), ship windows, scarcity/price/KO intel, rumor watch flagged [uncertain]; content from `data/drop-week.json` via `scripts/build_dropweek.py`
- `api/v1/compare.json` — VS-mode figure profiles (1,939, wave 26): stable `deepLink` (`waves/<waveId>.html#fig-<slug>`), shareable `compareUrl` (`compare.html?a=<id>`), `rarity` tier cross-ref, `priceSignals[]` (reported ranges, never live), `koWatch` note, `upgradePaths[]` (documented other releases of the same character, relation-labeled, capped at 8); derived from committed data by `scripts/compare_lib.py`; item schema `compare-profile.json`
- `api/v1/year-review.json` — 2026: The State of Legends (wave 27): scored Top-10 2026 releases with transparent distinction criteria, 2026 archive stats, reported-price movement math (reported solds only, never an index), best-value picks, KO watch, rarity highlights, honest gaps; content from `data/year-review.json` via `scripts/build_review.py`; powers `2026-review.html`; item schema `year-review-item.json`
- `api/v1/schema/` — JSON Schema (draft-07) for every endpoint (manifest, stats, waves, figures, encyclopedia, preorders, characters, timeline, rarity, price-signals, launch-curves, drop-week, compare, year-review, radar) plus per-record item schemas

## Skills (agentic task procedures)

220 skills in `skills/` — rebuild with `python3 scripts/build_skills.py`
(generates from `data/*.json` + authored procedures; outputs committed).
`skills/index.json` is the manifest: id, title, description, path per skill.

For agents: load the skill whose task matches the request — skills are the
primary interface for *doing* work; the JSON endpoints are the data layer.
`api/v1/index.json` points here (`repository`, `skills`, `for_agents`).

Categories: agents (8 playbooks: preorder-hunter, market-brief-reader,
ko-spotter, grail-evaluator, baf-strategist, collection-auditor, api-client,
launch-strategist),
baf (101 completion checklists), characters (46 collector guides),
grails (24 dossiers), bootleg (8), eras (5), collection (5), marketplace (4),
community (4), variants (4), hunts (11).

The agents category uses an "API references" section (pointing at
`api/v1` endpoints) instead of "Data references"; see the agents
landing page (`agents.html`) for the endpoint table, data-freshness
rules (preorder dates, radar, observed 2026-10-12), and 3 worked
agent workflows (proven by `tests/test-api-workflows.js` against the
real `api/v1` JSON).

## Stable ids

Figure ids are `<waveId>::<figureName>`, e.g. `toybiz-2002-series-1::Hulk`.
Wave ids are kebab-case slugs. Ids are stable; new figures get new ids, never recycled.
Unknown or disputed values are explicit `null` with a `notes` field — never invented.
- "Featured In" source facet: 29 of 167 waves (181 figures) classified as MCU / animated /
  video-game, only where the wave name explicitly names the source; everything else is
  `source: null` (Unclassified) rather than guessed. Coverage is stated on the page.

## Known limitations

- Within-year ordering is year-accurate but not audited to the month.
- Some BAF pieces and disputed wave numbers are flagged unverified in notes.
- Hall-of-fame prices are secondary-market observations; entries from single or
  tabloid sources carry `verified: false`.
- Encyclopedia claims added 2026-10-11 carry `source` + `confidence`
  (`verified` / `single-source` / `anecdote` / `unverified` / `analysis`).
- Marketplace links on the site are pre-filled search links (mock integration),
  not live inventory.

## Regenerating the API

`python3 scripts/build_api.py` rebuilds `api/v1/` from `data/figures.json`
and `data/encyclopedia.json`. Commit the outputs.

## Site structure

- `index.html` — chronological timeline with search, filters (incl. "Featured In" story-source facet), year rail, tracker, milestone-anniversary strip, packaging-era bands (5 documented eras from the encyclopedia's packaging guide)
- `timeline.html` — The Legends Timeline: year-by-year line history 2002–2026 (25 years, all 167 waves linked into the archive) — sourced milestones (Toy Biz launch, BAF birth 2005, Hasbro takeover 2007, Infinite Series 2014, retro cardbacks, 20th anniversary 2022, HasLab, Fan Channel, Epic Heroes 2023), 5 packaging eras, spotlight figures, era filter, keyboard-navigable year rail; content generated from `data/timeline-content.json` by `scripts/build_timeline.py` (cross-refs asserted); API at `api/v1/timeline.json`; cross-linked from every wave page + `encyclopedia.html#history`
- `2026-review.html` — 2026: The State of Legends (wave 27): data-driven year-in-review — 5 encyclopedia waves dated 2026 (114 figures), 21 tracker items, scored Top-10 2026 releases with shown distinction criteria, best-value picks from announced MSRPs, price movements from reported solds only, 8 biggest surprises, KO watch, rarity highlights, month-by-month scrubber timeline, market narrative arc; cross-links to timeline / market briefing / rarity guide / radar / encyclopedia / VS mode; content from `data/year-review.json` via `scripts/build_review.py`; API at `api/v1/year-review.json`
- `rarity.html` — The Rarity Guide: chase vs variant vs exclusive vs limited — 9 tiers (chase, running changes, deco variants, unmasked, convention, store, Pulse/Fan Channel, HasLab, made-to-order) with documented examples (real archive ids, build-asserted), how-to-spot tells, value notes (reported prices only, never an index), rare = faked / rarity ≠ value / rarity ≠ quality cross-cutting sections, and Grail Quest achievement mapping; content generated from `data/rarity-guide.json` by `scripts/build_rarity.py` (example ids + sources asserted); API at `api/v1/rarity.json`; cross-linked from market briefing (chase-era card), Auth Wizard (rare = faked), Gift Finder (rarest gift picks `?for=collector`), encyclopedia, variants, exclusives, grails
- `grails.html` — 23 sourced grail stories expanding the hall of fame (incl. 3 NYCC 2026 additions: Trask & Bastion made-to-order, Lord Doom Concept Series, Death Gambit)
- `variants.html` — variant & chase identifier: spotter's guide + wave-by-wave index of documented variants
- `checklist.html` — printable owned/wanted checklist from tracker data, grouped by wave
- `encyclopedia.html` — history, packaging evolution, variants/chases/exclusives, hall of fame, grading guide, bootleg guide, resources
- `baf-planner.html` — "complete my BAF" planner (browser-local, syncs with tracker): ownership = tracker marks + logged ledger purchases; "closest to complete" ranking (fewest missing pieces first); cheapest-path math per missing piece — journal-logged sold prices first, figure-type tier proxy otherwise, known-path estimate labeled as your own data
- `characters/index.html` + `characters/<slug>.html` — 66 generated character archive pages (rebuild with `python3 scripts/build_characters.py`); `characters/manifest.json` lists slug, name, count, first/last year per character; every release row carries a `data-fig-id` and a per-figure "Research" affordance (eBay solds / YouTube reviews / web search links); each page shows your run-completion progress bar ("N of M owned") with a missing-figure complete-the-run checklist, read live from the localStorage tracker via `assets/js/char-run.js`
- `price-guide.html` — transparent sold-listings methodology, dated price history, reissue effect
- `launch-curve.html` — The Launch Curve (wave 30): real sold-price timelines for newly launched figures (Doomsday Wave 1 Gambit $79.99 → $25.99, Cyclops $64.99 → $40.99 — reported eBay solds, actionfigure411), static SVG charts with MSRP lines + sellout event markers, the sellout → spike → cool → retail pattern, the launch playbook (pre-order at 1 PM ET, never pay the launch premium, watchlist targets at/below MSRP for mainline), methodology + honest gaps; scroll-driven chart-draw + card reveals (progressive enhancement, reduced-motion gated); content from `data/launch-curves.json` via `scripts/build_launch.py`; API at `api/v1/launch-curves.json`; cross-linked from radar, market briefing, quest prep section, and the `launch-strategist` agent playbook
- `market-briefing.html` — 2026 market briefing: the death of modern chase figures, reported solds (white Dr. Doom $115–$200, most recent sold $200 Aug 2026; $7.5K Wasp prototype ask), reissue-cooling of aftermarket premiums (Retro Venom reissue, TAS wave Dec 2026–Jan 2027 ship), KO buyer-beware (no new 2026 KO wave; official Maximum Symbiote Spider-Man vs AliExpress Maximum Spider-Man KO listings), post-NYCC refresh (Oct 11, 2026: Oct 14/21/28 + Nov 1 window sequence, Doomsday FF in stores, white Doom no new solds), mid-October sweep (Oct 12: all windows reconfirmed, launch curves live — Gambit $79.99 → $25.99, Cyclops $64.99 → $40.99, white Doom band stands, Super-Skrull reissue + Cypher added to tracker), holiday-season gift-timing notes cross-linked to the Gift Finder, reported-listings-only methodology
- `auth-wizard.html` — interactive bootleg authentication wizard
- `shelf.html` — "your shelf" dashboard: read-only completion stats (overall/year/era/top characters/BAF) aggregated from the localStorage tracker
- `radar.html` — release radar: revealed-but-unreleased figures with source links, maintained from hobby press (21 cards; wave-24 added the Maximum Symbiote Spider-Man reveal)
- `preorders.html` — pre-order tracker: researched upcoming releases with live status countdowns, retailer search links, personal ordered/watching/skipped calls; 🎁 gift-ready flags on pre-orderable items at ≤$35 announced MSRP (links to the holiday guide + gift finder)
- `calendar.html` — 12-month release calendar: exact pre-order dates on a month grid, keyboard navigable, season-only releases listed below
- `preorders.html` — pre-order tracker: status, live countdowns, retailer search links, your ordered/watching/skipped calls (localStorage `mlc_preorders_v1`), fed by `data/preorders.json`
- `calendar.html` — 12-month release calendar (Oct 2026 → Sep 2027): exact pre-order dates plotted, keyboard-navigable, ARIA-labeled, reduced-motion safe; season-only releases listed below
- `compare.html` — figure compare (VS mode): 2–4 figures side-by-side — release info, archive notes, reported price bands (reported, never live), rarity signals, KO watch, documented upgrade paths, honest "which to buy" guidance (no winner declared); shareable links (`compare.html?a=<id>&b=<id>`), keyboard operable, mobile-first
- `community.html` — fan social (localStorage demo)
- `quest.html` — Grail Quest 4.0: your collection as a game — auto-generated quests (BAF finishes, series/character runs) from your tracker data, next-quest recommendations (closest BAF, cheapest missing piece by figure-type proxy — watch-weighted when a watched figure's reported market nears your target, nearest watchlist grail, watchlist hunts ranked by reported-market-vs-target closeness, insight pick from the gap analysis), 17 achievements (15 archive-signal/user-derived + Character Loyalist — full character run, Archivist — 50 figures logged), collector levels (Rookie → Living Legend), pre-order alerts (confirmed pre-order dates in the next 30 days, from `data/preorders.json` via `upcomingPreorders`), launch-day prep quests (Grail Quest 5.0: tickable checklists for pre-order/sale windows opening in the next 14 days via `launchPrep`, ticks persist browser-local in `mlc_launchprep_v1`), collection insights dashboard (completion % by wave/year/character, duplicate-logging nudge, shelf-value band from reported ranges only — never an appraisal, one-figure-away gap analysis), growth & milestones view (cumulative growth from Ledger purchase dates, honest "since you started logging" framing), collection report export (markdown, copy/download, for insurance/records — your records, not a valuation), shareable quest card (level, archive progress %, active quests, next-quest list, latest achievement) — same "Copy my quest" export on `showcase.html` (browser-local)
- `holiday.html` — 2026 Holiday Buying Guide: four recipient profiles rendered from `data/preorders.json` (no invented figures/prices), honest price bands, KO red flags, reissue intel, don't-get-burned checklist
- `grading.html` — condition & grading guide: the C-10 to C-1 collector scale (carded vs loose meanings per grade, shorthand bands) rendered from `assets/js/grading.js`; MOC/MIB/loose distinctions; what affects value (card corners, bubble clarity/yellowing, paint apps, joint tightness, completeness incl. BAF pieces/accessories); photographing flaws for listings; never-do list (no solvents, no sun-fading fixes, no resealing, no over-grading); related-tools links to journal/showcase/quest; cross-linked from `journal.html` ("grade before you log") and `encyclopedia.html#grading`
- `display.html` — display & storage guide: UV protection (direct sunlight the #1 killer), individual acrylic cases vs glass cabinets (Detolf style), humidity/temperature basics, dust management, earthquake-proofing (museum putty, anchoring, heavy pieces low), rotating displays, photographing the collection, room-by-room guidance; related-tools links to shelf/showcase/quest; cross-linked from `encyclopedia.html#packaging`
- `drop-week.html` — Drop Week Command Center: the Oct 14 → Nov 1 drop sequence + Nov 20 MTO deadline — Oct 14 Doomsday Wave 2 (Beast/Nightcrawler/Lord Doom, $27.99, 1 PM ET), Oct 21 X-Men '97 wave (6 figures), Oct 28 Astonishing Cyclops & Wolverine 2-pack reissue (price unannounced), Nov 1 YFNS Spider-Man vs. Rhino Pulse-exclusive sale day, Nov 20 Trask & Bastion $74.99 made-to-order deadline; live countdowns (client clock), confirmed lineups with researched accessory breakdowns, price/scarcity/KO intel, morning-of playbook (1 PM ET pattern, Pulse-lag caution), rumor watch flagged [uncertain]; personal battle plan per figure (want → ordered, `mlc_dropweek_v1`, browser-local, copy-to-share); breadcrumb + sticky in-page wayfinding rail, container-query drop cards, reduced-motion safe; data from `data/drop-week.json` via `scripts/build_dropweek.py` (writes `api/v1/drop-week.json` + schemas + noscript fallback; registered as the 16th manifest endpoint at merge)
- `vault-room.html` — The Vault Room: browsable collector's vault — 25 year-shelves (2002→2026) from the real `api/v1` datasets, 1,939 figure drawers on 167 wave shelf-boards, each opening an archive-drawer dialog (accession №, variant/exclusive/BAF badges, wave/year/manufacturer, archive notes, timeline year's headline + packaging, spotlight "why", wave/character links, owned/wanted tracker, research links); the drawer index: full-text search across all 1,939 drawers (pure `searchDrawers` ranking — name > variant/exclusive > wave/BAF > notes/year/manufacturer, AND tokens, 50-result cap, debounced) with combobox keyboard navigation (↑↓/Home/End/Enter/Esc, `aria-activedescendant`, live status line), instant (no motion) so reduced-motion readers get the full index; sticky 2002→2026 journey rail (aria-current follows scroll); deep-link `#fig=<id>`; lazy-rendered shelves; engine `assets/js/vault-room.js`
- `api.html` — human-readable API docs
- `assets/css/` — tokens, base, layout, components, timeline, encyclopedia, community, print (print.css: paper-friendly timeline + checklist output)
- `assets/js/` — config, store, data, tracker, listings, modal, figure-dialog,
  timeline, encyclopedia, baf-planner, price-guide, auth-wizard, shelf, compare, compare-guide, variants, checklist, history-strip, era-bands, community, community-page, explore, retro, showcase, gallery, gallery-core, gift, holiday, grading, shelf-share, price-trends, quest, quest-core, quest-share, ko-targets, timeline-page, price-watch, budget, budget-core, insights, drop-command, vault-room (ES modules)
